item.title: IDF striking in Lebanon after soldiers intercepted a drone launched by Hezbollah terrorists
item.description:
Earlier on Friday, terrorists from the Hezbollah terrorist organization launched a drone towards IDF soldiers operating in the Security Zone in southern Lebanon, the IDF Spokesperson's Unit said.
According to the statement, IDF soldiers opened fire and downed the drone. No IDF injuries were reported. "The IDF is currently operating and will continue to act with determination against Hezbollah’s repeated attempts to harm IDF soldiers," said the IDF.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: Gilad Erdan: Unity Party pulls out of upcoming elections

item.title: Political drama: Erdan withdraws from race
item.description:
Gilad Erdan announced that the Unity Party he founded will not run in the upcoming elections.
According to Erdan, the party's current level of support does not make it highly likely to cross the electoral threshold, while efforts to join forces with additional parties have also failed to materialize.
